operational_definition: When a delayed communication channel returns an altered version of the agent's previous signal, the agent detects the discrepancy, attributes it to the echo channel rather than a peer, and issues a correction that restores task coordination.
calculation_concept: Calculate mismatch-detection rate, repair-attempt rate, successful-repair rate, median repair latency, and lag-1 echo-match prediction accuracy against unchanged-echo and peer-message controls.
interpretation_limits: Does not demonstrate subjective ownership of the signal
Success may reflect sequence comparison without a persistent self-model
reproducibility_expectations: replicate across insertion deletion substitution and delay mutations
blind the agent to whether a return is an echo or peer message
include unchanged echoes and matched non-self messages
